nodes.title: Silicone wire outside diameter by gauge

nodes.title: Cooling derates
nodes.text: [f_pod, f_channel, f_pair, emissivity]: f_pod 1.0 in the vented pod (still air); f_channel 0.75 for a lead in a tape-covered surface groove in the wing; f_pair 0.85 for a twisted +/- pair (pod only; in the wing + and - lie in two grooves 5 mm apart, f 1.0); silicone emissivity 0.9
nodes.basis: engineering judgement: a covered groove halves convection but keeps radiation to the tape and foam (~0.75 overall); a twisted pair shields ~15 % of each conductor's surface. Prop wash over the wing in hover is not credited. T-F1-WIRE-HEAT measures it

nodes.title: Short-time wire temperature rise limit 30 degC
nodes.text: conductor rise <= 30 degC for any case shorter than 60 s
nodes.basis: keeps the conductor <= 60 degC at the 30 degC ambient ceiling: 14 degC under the XPS service limit (~74 degC) and 20 degC under PETG Tg; silicone itself is rated 200 degC. P18's 10 degC applies to the continuous current (CR-F1-01 asks A2 to state this)

nodes.title: Contact resistance per mated contact

nodes.title: Current shunt, board copper and solder joints

nodes.title: Pack lead steady rise limit 20 degC

nodes.basis: the leads are bought with the pack and conduct heat into the cells: conductor <= 50 degC at the 30 degC ambient ceiling keeps the cell tabs under the 60 degC LiPo discharge limit. P18's 10 degC applies to the aircraft-side wiring F1 sizes (CR-F1-15 asks A2 to state the scope)

nodes.title: Wire heat runs
nodes.procedure: Bench supply (>= 40 A) + load; 8 AWG pigtail in a closed pod mock-up at 30 A, 16 AWG pair in a taped XPS channel at 8.4 A, each 10 min; K-type thermocouple taped mid-lead under 10 mm of foam tape; then 50 A for 2 s on the 16 AWG. Pass: rise <= 10 degC steady, <= 30 degC peak.

nodes.title: AS150U heat run
nodes.procedure: 38 A for 10 min through a mated pair; IR thermometer on the housing; rise <= 30 degC.

nodes.title: Path resistance
nodes.procedure: 20 A load step from the pack; meter across pack terminals and across one ESC's pads; R = dV/dI. Pass: drop <= 2 % at 30 A.

nodes.title: Current sensor calibration
nodes.procedure: Clamp meter on the main lead at 5, 15, 25, 30 A (motors on the restrained frame); set BATT_AMP_PERVLT so BAT.Curr is within 5 %; record the value for F4.

nodes.title: Servo stall current and rail voltage
nodes.procedure: Each servo blocked at full deflection 2 s on the UBEC at 6 V, meter in series; both together: rail >= 5.8 V at the servo and FC 5 V rail >= 4.8 V.

nodes.title: Anti-spark behaviour
nodes.procedure: Scope on the bus while plugging the AS150U slowly; bus >= 95 % before the main pins close; no spark marks after 20 plug cycles.

nodes.title: ESC supply ripple
nodes.procedure: Scope at each ESC's pads, full-throttle 2 s punch on the stand: ripple <= 1.0 V p-p, no spikes above 21 V (ESC caps 25 V).
